parsed.name: QuTech双工器
parsed.description: 这是一台用于微波实验的多通道双工器，可对通道开关状态、相位和衰减进行统一设置，并支持与衰减标定相关的计算。
parsed.description_en: A multi-channel duplexer for microwave experiments, supporting bulk control of switch states, phase, and attenuation, as well as attenuation-related scaling calculations.
